title: Episode 04A — Ankita: Rinku, Household, Kabir & Night Closure

continuityStart.moment: Rinku rings the doorbell; Ankita has not opened the door.
continuityStart.twins: Karan and Aman brought Ankita home by about 17:50; their ride is already in Episode 03 Scene 07, not replayed here.
continuityStart.officeChotu: Rohit has been introduced on January 1 at work; no second office visit on January 1.
continuityStart.wardrobe: Comfortable cotton kurti and relaxed trousers, without dupatta; exact color, neckline and fit are not locked.

beats.title: Doorbell → repair reason
beats.plot: Ankita opens the door from the Episode 03 cliff. Rinku has a small tool pouch and matches the washer against the leaking water-filter connector. Established service familiarity; no re-introduction or wardrobe changes.

beats.title: A shared practical task
beats.plot: Rinku crouches by the sink cabinet; Ankita stands at the accessible shutoff valve and holds a dry towel nearby. The coupler is cracked. He warns her before releasing it; the pressure surges unexpectedly.

beats.title: The accidental physical moment
beats.plot: The coupling spits a concentrated burst of water across Ankita's cotton kurti and forearm. Stepping onto the suddenly slippery tile, she catches Rinku's clothed upper arm for balance while he braces the loose fitting. Their shoulders come close for two or three seconds; she releases once steady. Neither arranges the contact.

beats.title: Sightline, recognition and quiet change
beats.plot: The wet outer kurti temporarily makes the outline of her existing inner clothing visible through the cloth; no bare chest or exposed breast. Rinku's eyes catch the changed fabric for an instant, then turn back to the pipe. Ankita notices that he went unusually quiet, but she cannot tell whether it was the leak or her appearance. Unlike Dhika's bending event, the visual trigger is wet fabric and the physical trigger is an involuntary arm hold.

beats.title: Repair exit and unresolved question
beats.plot: Rinku secures a temporary fitting, explains that the exact replacement connector is needed for a permanent pressure check, and leaves without a new confession or staged second look. Ankita changes into dry clothing after he goes; her later feeling is a brief, self-aware shiver about the unexpected closeness and his silence, not an invented first-ever attraction.

scenes.title: Household reset — Rajeev remains away

beats.title: Dry clothes and the quiet apartment
beats.plot: After Rinku's temporary repair, Ankita gets into dry, comfortable home clothes and returns to her ordinary household tasks. The question raised by Rinku's abrupt quietness stays private. No second encounter or deliberate display tonight.

beats.title: Rajeev's absence, not a new mystery
beats.plot: Ankita knows Rajeev has stepped out for an important errand, without an expected return time. He took his own key. She does not engage the inside bolt; the ordinary door latch can be opened using his key. His errand and the private parcel remain unseen and undiscussed. Karan and Aman are still out at pre-existing society activities, including their 19:11–19:23 Shivani and 20:16–20:24 Taniya commitments.

scenes.householdLock: Rajeev is absent on an unspecified important errand; reader is NOT told what. His return time remains open. No secret parcel handover.

scenes.title: Karan and Aman come home

beats.title: Two brothers back from society
beats.plot: After their established ~20:24 society event, Karan and Aman return to their shared apartment. Ordinary dinner and brief chat; Ankita does not tease them into a new intimate encounter. She can remind Aman about his Java interview notes without starting a long work scene. Neither brother knows her private Rinku thoughts.

scenes.continuity: Their return at 20:40 is PROPOSED and must be revisited if other locked overnight scenes conflict.

scenes.title: Kabir's work call and arrival
scenes.location: Office call → Gulmohar Heights · Malhotra apartment

beats.title: Short reassuring call
beats.plot: Kabir calls from work to say his release-related office duties ran late but he is coming home tonight. Ankita asks about his tiredness and responds warmly. He does not interrogate her day; she simply says work and the New Year celebration went well.

beats.title: Kabir returns
beats.plot: Kabir reaches home, is welcomed affectionately and freshens up. Do not cast him as absent for the entire night or copy Dhika/John's overnight absence. He knows nothing about Ankita's private testing of attention or other men's undisclosed thoughts.

scenes.continuity: Exact office exit and commute remain author-review proposals, not previously established workplace facts.

scenes.title: A familiar marriage, very little explanation

beats.title: Natural husband-wife warmth
beats.plot: Kabir asks whether Ankita enjoyed her day. She replies briefly, 'Haan, kaafi eventful tha,' without reciting Bhalla, Sandeep, the briefing buttons, the party's private moments, the Aman ride or Rinku's changed gaze. They talk about his late work, tomorrow's routine and being together. Nothing suggests their established marriage was unhappy or unsatisfying.

scenes.title: Before bed — the day belongs to her thoughts

beats.title: One vivid private recall, not a checklist
beats.plot: In her own thoughts Ankita remembers the morning compliments (Rohan, Nikhil and the fitness group), office comments by Priya/Nisha, her OWN decision to loosen two kurti buttons in front of Bhalla and Sandeep, the party's dancing, the unusual scooter closeness with Aman, and the kitchen accident with Rinku. The reader may understand that different men interpreted her differently, but Ankita cannot recall hidden fantasies, privacy violations or secret parcel activity she never learned about.

beats.title: Charged feelings turn toward her husband
beats.plot: The day has left her unusually energized, self-aware and physically stirred. She remembers that she chose some moments of playful attention, while others surprised her. There is no assumed consent for others and no invented guilt. She wants closeness with Kabir, and decides to initiate it herself.

scenes.prosePreview: Poore din ki tasveerein ek saath laut aayin—subah ke compliments, briefing mein uske apne khole hue do buttons, party ka dance, scooty ka woh unexpected moment, aur kitchen mein Rinku ki achanak khamoshi. Kuch lamhe usne khud chune the, kuch bina soche ho gaye. Aaj woh khud ko unusually excited mehsoos kar rahi thi. Kabir uske paas tha; is waqt uska dil usi ke kareeb jaana chahta tha.

scenes.title: Ankita takes the initiative — fade to black

beats.title: Confident, mutual married intimacy
beats.plot: Ankita approaches Kabir and initiates affectionate intimacy with noticeably more eagerness than usual. Kabir recognizes how excited and proactive she is, responds with equal affection and enthusiasm, and both willingly share an unusually intense, fulfilling night together. Do NOT describe sexual acts graphically, and do not have Ankita reveal her private day-recall to Kabir. Fade to black as the intimacy begins.

beats.title: Tenderness and sleep
beats.plot: After the fade to black, briefly return only to the comfortable, loving aftermath: both are content, Kabir checks that Ankita is comfortable, and they fall asleep as caring partners. Their already-good married intimacy feels newly refreshed, not repaired from a fabricated problem.

scenes.prosePreview:
Kabir ne uske chehre ki alag-si chamak aur uski aaj ki bejhijhak pehel mehsoos ki. Woh muskuraya; Ankita ne bhi usse utni hi garmahat se apne kareeb bula liya. Us raat dono ne apni shaadi ki pehle se pyaari nazdeekiyon ko ek nayi intensity ke saath jiya.

*Fade to black.*

Baad mein, ek-doosre ka khayal rakhte hue, dono sukoon aur pyaar ke saath so gaye. Ankita ko mehsoos hua ki aaj ki raat ne unke achhe relationship ko kuch aur khaas bana diya tha.

Scenes 02–07 are night-closure proposals for author's review. The pre-existing Scene 01 five beats are untouched.
Kabir learns only ordinary broad details, not Ankita's internal inventory or any men's private/unknown behavior.
Husband-wife sexual connection is mutually enthusiastic and off-page (fade-to-black), followed by caring sleep.
Rajeev's unspecified important errand, own key, and unbolted door remain fixed planning constraints; no arbitrary nighttime entrance.
No new intimate activity involving either devar in the household scene.
